# Yoga Benchmark

Skill how to run and execute benchamrk in this repo

# How it works

Benchmark are compared to 'baseline', so version of the code on the main branch before any changes. When you run benchmark, it will compare results of current code with the baseline and show you the difference.

## Usage

When a user asks you to run benchmark, you should:

1. Execute './run_benchmark_compare.sh compare' command in 'benchmark' directory
2. Parse results
3. Analyze them
